run_query: run the query function to transcribe an audio file using the Hugging Face Inference API
create_function_read_audio: create a function that reads an audio file in binary mode and sends it to an API endpoint
test_query: test the query function with a FLAC audio file and verify the JSON response
refactor_query: refactor the query function to support multiple audio formats beyond FLAC
review_query: review the query function that sends audio data to the Hugging Face Whisper model inference endpoint
